model.title: How the value figure is built
model.description: The Value Generated panel turns resolved tickets into money in three steps:
model.stepLlm: Measure the actual LLM spend: every task records the input/output/cache tokens of each model call, valued with each model's price table (Claude reports its real USD cost directly).
model.stepHuman: Estimate what the same work would have cost by hand: man-hours credited per ticket × hourly rate.
model.stepFee: The difference between the two is the savings; the service fee is the configured percentage of that savings.

humanCost.title: Human cost assumptions
humanCost.description: Used to estimate what the resolved tickets would have cost done by hand.

hourlyRate.label: Hourly rate
hourlyRate.helper: Fully-loaded cost of one hour of engineering work.
hourlyRate.error: Enter a rate greater than zero.

currency.label: Currency
currency.helper: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, EUR, UYU.

hoursPerTask.label: Hours saved per ticket
hoursPerTask.helper: Default man-hours credited to each resolved ticket. Can be overridden per task from the dashboard.

hoursPerFte.label: Hours per FTE per month
hoursPerFte.helper: Working hours in a month, used to express saved hours as full-time equivalents.

fee.title: Service fee
fee.description: The invoice is a percentage of the net savings: you pay for what you save.

feePercent.label: Percentage of savings
feePercent.helper: Share of the monthly net savings that is invoiced. Default: 10%.

llmCost.title: LLM spend
llmCost.detail: Every task accumulates the input/output/cache tokens of each model call. Known models are converted to USD with their price table and Claude reports its actual cost; tasks whose agent reports no cost are flagged in the panel as missing cost data.

push.helper: Show system notifications when workspaces finish running.

desktop.label: Desktop Alerts
desktop.helper: Show browser notifications when tasks finish, fail, or await approval. Requires notification permission.

desktop.helperInsecure: Desktop alerts require a secure context (HTTPS or localhost).

browserPush.label: Alerts with the browser closed
browserPush.helper: Receive push notifications even when no fluke tab is open. Uses the vendor push service (FCM/Mozilla) and the same events as Desktop Alerts.
browserPush.helperDenied: Notifications are blocked by the browser. Update the site permission to enable push.
browserPush.helperUnsupported: Web Push requires a secure context (HTTPS or localhost) and a browser that supports service workers.

defaultWorkingDir.helper: Subdirectory relative to the repository root where the coding agent runs for single-repo workspaces. Set when the workspace is created. Leave empty to use the repository root.

scripts.title: Scripts & Configuration
scripts.description: Configure dev server, setup, cleanup, and copy files for this repository. These scripts run whenever the repository is used in any workspace.

setup.label: Setup Script
setup.helper: This script runs from within the worktree after it's created and before the coding agent starts. Use it for setup tasks like installing dependencies or preparing the environment.
setup.parallelLabel: Run setup script in parallel with coding agent
setup.parallelHelper: When enabled, the setup script runs simultaneously with the coding agent instead of waiting for setup to complete first.

cleanup.label: Cleanup Script
cleanup.helper: This script runs from within the worktree after coding agent execution, only if changes were made. Use it for quality assurance tasks like running linters, formatters, tests, or other validation steps.

archive.label: Archive Script
archive.helper: This script runs from within the worktree when the workspace is archived. Use it for cleanup tasks like stopping services, releasing resources, or saving state.

copyFiles.label: Copy Files
copyFiles.helper: Comma-separated list of files to copy from the original repository directory to the worktree. Useful for environment files like .env. Make sure these are gitignored!
copyFiles.placeholder: File paths or glob patterns (e.g., .env, config/*.json)

devServer.label: Dev Server Script
devServer.helper: Starts a development server for this repository. Scripts execute from within the repository's worktree directory.
